openings.claim: Speculative: an indexed pocket using contact boundaries instead of magnetism/friction may retain the weak-magnet spare and enable gloved swaps. Drilled strips bolt through existing slots into side capture/end stops behind the edge, with a movable fourth-strip gate providing an edge-free handling point. Wire may recover hardware. Pickup needs accessible unmarked surface; gate is not assumed to lift plate.
openings.discriminator: Nearest rival: cork-lined friction strip clamp. With light seating pressure, pocket should hold spare within 1 mm; reduced clamp pressure may allow drift. Equal success leaves distinction unresolved. Cage drift, trapped extraction or slow gloved servicing defeats capability.
openings.probe: Map slots, clearance, exposed edge and pickup access with ruler/marker. Before fabrication verify strip bendability, bolt fit and pocket play <1 mm; abandon if geometry prevents capture. Using supplied strips/bolts/pads, build at most pocket and rival within 80 minutes. Observe within 20 minutes: up to three twenty-manual-stroke runs/configuration, ruler/stroke counter, displacement and qualitative seating pressure; spare in final run. Stopwatch up to three thick-gloved removal/return checks/configuration: <=60 seconds, no marked-edge contact. Optional pull-scale escape comparison <=10 N cannot establish resistance to unknown stroke forces. Stop for clearance intrusion or necessary edge contact.
openings.uncertainty: Slot dimensions/locations must permit mounting outside clearance; supplied pliers must form sufficiently stiff strips; available bolts/strips must support capture/gloved gate. Stroke duration may limit informative comparisons; fewer runs reduce confidence. Hard constraints: no drilling, cutting, heating or gluing plate/carriage; keep 30 mm working edge exposed, added parts outside stroke clearance, carriage attached to rails.

lineage.reason: Retains causal relation, complete rival/defeat test, resource/stopping caveats, uncertain fit and assumptions.

decision: Check geometry before the bounded enabling experiment. Reduced magnetic dependence addresses the anomaly; retention/serviceability remain unproven. No deployment claim.
